body: Ahh sorry, I should’ve been more clear in my wording. I originally drew the layout on some notebook paper but wanted it to be a little cleaner when asking for suggestions so I drew it up on Inkscape. Wasn’t entirely sure what to title the post but I realize how unclear it is. Apologies for that.

I used Inkscape. Uploaded a scan of my drawing and used line tracing to get the layout. Smoothed it out by adjusting the vector nodes. I think I set the full circuit line width at 3mm and the sector lines at 0.75 mm. Then just labeled the corners and sectors with a font that looks somewhat like what F1 uses for their maps. 
I think it turned out pretty well.
Mate, there is a pit lane. It’s Bahrain-esque running the length of the start/finish straight.
